hostedLegal.accept: I have read and accept the Timeax terms of use.
hostedLegal.required: Read and accept the current terms to create your workspace.
hostedLegal.serviceBody: Timeax helps track working hours and share timesheets. Available features depend on your role and organization settings. Registration does not start a paid subscription.
hostedLegal.accountBody: Use a working email address and do not share your password or codes. Use an up-to-date browser with JavaScript and essential cookies enabled.
hostedLegal.organizationBody: If you create a workspace on behalf of an organization, make sure you are authorized to do so. Email verification does not grant access to an existing organization. Only add data you are permitted to process.
hostedLegal.helpBody: For access issues, errors or complaints, contact the Timeax operator, Roman Pysanyi. Describe the issue but do not send passwords, codes or workers’ documents.
hostedLegal.closingBody: You can stop using Timeax and ask support to close your account. Closing an account does not release an organization from its record retention obligations.

hostedPrivacy.recipientsBody: Supabase provides authentication and application data storage, Render hosts Timeax, and AZ.pl email sends codes to the address you supply.
hostedPrivacy.responsibilityTitle: Who is responsible for the data
hostedPrivacy.responsibilityBody: The Timeax operator is responsible for processing email addresses, account details and information needed to protect sign-in where it determines the purposes and means of that processing. A one-time code is for signing in, not for subscribing to marketing.
hostedPrivacy.recordsBody: An agency that records and approves working hours and uses them for payroll is responsible for processing for those purposes. Timeax acts as a processor when it handles workforce data on the instructions of the agency or factory. Access depends on the person’s role and permissions.
hostedPrivacy.factoryBody: Listing a factory only as a worksite in the agency workspace does not give that factory access. A separately connected factory that keeps its own hours records as the user employer of temporary workers is responsible for processing for that purpose. The agency and user employer agree in writing what information affecting a temporary worker’s pay is shared, how and when.
hostedPrivacy.requestsTitle: Account data: access, correction and deletion
hostedPrivacy.requestsBody: For account data, contact the Timeax operator, Roman Pysanyi. For working hours, timesheets and payslips, contact the organization that maintains those records. Closing an account does not delete records an organization must keep. Data protection complaints can be filed with the Polish supervisory authority, UODO.
hostedPrivacy.noteHint: Enter only what is needed for the calculation or correction. Do not enter diagnoses, treatment information, document numbers or other people’s personal data.
hostedPrivacy.title: How Timeax handles data
hostedPrivacy.limit: Provide only the data needed for the action you are taking.
hostedPrivacy.beforeEmail: Before entering your email address, see how data is used to verify access.
hostedPrivacy.accessBody: We use your email address to send a one-time verification code during registration and your password to let you sign in. Verification emails are not marketing messages.
hostedPrivacy.dataBody: To set up an agency workspace we use the organization name and its Polish tax ID (NIP). Entering a NIP does not verify authority or give access to an existing workspace.
hostedPrivacy.storageBody: The service uses session mechanisms to operate and secure sign-in. Your chosen language or theme may be remembered in this browser.
